Downstream Migration Guidance for addin.tools Deprecations

Source: .github/downstream-deprecation-guidance.md

This package keeps compatibility aliases for renamed helpers, but downstream packages should migrate proactively.

Current rename

  • is_rmd_visual_mode() has been renamed to is_visual_editor().
  • The old name remains as a deprecated wrapper for now.

Recommended downstream changes

  1. Replace imports/usages:
    • is_rmd_visual_mode() -> is_visual_editor()
  2. Update namespace imports:
    • importFrom(addin.tools, is_rmd_visual_mode) -> importFrom(addin.tools, is_visual_editor)
  3. Update tests:
    • Change expectations and fixtures to call is_visual_editor() directly.
  4. Update user-facing docs:
    • Change README text, examples, and help topics to the new name.
  5. Verify behavior:
    • Run package-local tests and R CMD check after the rename.

Compatibility policy

  • The alias will continue to work temporarily but emits a deprecation warning.
  • Downstream packages should treat the alias as transitional and remove it from new code.

Deprecation timetable

  • The compatibility wrapper remains available for at least one minor release after the rename.
  • Removal should not be considered before version 0.1.0.
  • Any future compatibility wrapper should document the target replacement and a removal milestone in this file and in NEWS.md.
